_what: The words the sign-in pages' script may show, taken from the sign-in words the pages were drawn with (sign_in_words: failed, unavailable; ways: not_sent, too_many, names_refused.email).
failed: That did not work. Try again.
unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
not_sent: The code could not be sent just now, so none is on its way. Try again in a minute.
too_many: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
email_needed: Type the email address you sign in with.
